rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for going with someone or keeping them company.

example.english: I’ll accompany you to see the doctor.
example.jyutping: ngo5 pui4 nei5 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1

rows.jyutping: tung4 A jat1 cai4 ceot1 jin6
rows.note: Use this when two things or events occur together rather than when someone physically goes with another person.

example.english: This symptom can accompany a fever.
example.traditional: 呢種症狀通常同發燒一齊出現。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 zing3 zong6 tung1 soeng4 tung4 faat3 siu1 jat1 cai4 ceot1 jin6

rows.note: Use this specifically when a musician or instrument provides a supporting musical part.

example.english: The piano will accompany this singer.
example.jyutping: gong1 kam4 wai4 ni1 wai2 go1 sau2 bun6 zau3

rows.note: Use this when an extra thing is added or supplied alongside something else.

example.english: Accompany the noodles with a fried egg, and they’ll be much more filling.
example.traditional: 加上隻煎蛋，碗麵即刻飽肚好多。
example.jyutping: gaa1 soeng5 zek3 zin1 daan6 wun2 min6 zik1 hak1 baau2 tou5 hou2 do1
